      "source": [
        "columns_for_analysis = ['Age', 'Height', 'Weight']\n",
        "for col in columns_for_analysis:\n",
        "    print(f\"Statistics for {col}:\")\n",
        "    print(\"Min:\", np.min(df[col].dropna()))\n",
        "    print(\"Max:\", np.max(df[col].dropna()))\n",
        "    print(\"Standard Deviation:\", np.std(df[col].dropna()))\n",
        "    print(\"Variance:\", np.var(df[col].dropna()))\n",
        "    print(\"\\n\")"
      ]

      "source": [
        "# Dealing with Missing Values:\n",
        "#df['Height'].fillna(df['Height'].median(), inplace=True)\n",
        "#df['Weight'].fillna(df['Weight'].median(), inplace=True)"

      "source": [
        "# Histrogram plots\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import seaborn as sns\n",
        "\n",
        "fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(18, 5))\n",
        "sns.histplot(df['Age'].dropna(), bins=30, kde=True, ax=axes[0])\n",
        "axes[0].set_title(\"Age Distribution\")\n",
        "sns.histplot(df['Height'].dropna(), bins=30, kde=True, ax=axes[1])\n",
        "axes[1].set_title(\"Height Distribution\")\n",
        "sns.histplot(df['Weight'].dropna(), bins=30, kde=True, ax=axes[2])\n",
        "axes[2].set_title(\"Weight Distribution\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "execution_count": null,
      "id": "92436fe3-f0e0-4a5e-b652-bcd1d84a5274",

      "source": [
        "# Correlation plots,\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))\n",
        "correlation_matrix = df[['Age', 'Height', 'Weight']].corr()\n",
        "sns.heatmap(correlation_matrix, annot=True, cmap=\"coolwarm\", fmt=\".2f\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Correlation Matrix of Age, Height, and Weight\")\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ]
    },

      "source": [
        "# Box plot for Height and Weight based on Sex\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(15, 5))\n",
        "for i, column in enumerate(['Height', 'Weight'], 1):\n",
        "    plt.subplot(1, 2, i)\n",
        "    sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Sex', y=column)\n",
        "    plt.title(f\"{column} by Sex\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ]
    },

      "cell_type": "code",

      "source": [
        "# Scatter plot for Height and Weight\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))\n",
        "sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Height', y='Weight', hue='Sex', palette={'M': 'blue', 'F': 'yellow'}, alpha=0.5)\n",
        "plt.title(\"Scatter Plot of Height vs Weight\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Height (cm)\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Weight (kg)\")\n",
        "plt.legend(title='Sex')\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ]
    },

      "source": [
        "from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression\n",
        "# Step 1: Prepare the data\n",
        "# Convert Medal column to binary (1 if won a medal, 0 otherwise)\n",
        "df['Medal_Won'] = df['Medal'].notna().astype(int)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Select relevant features for prediction\n",
        "x = df[['Age', 'Height', 'Weight']].dropna()\n",
        "y = df['Medal_Won'].loc[x.index]  # Ensure alignment with features\n",
        "\n",
        "# Step 3: Train the model\n",
        "model = LogisticRegression()\n",
        "model"
      ]
    },

        "subset_df = df.sample(500, random_state=42)\n",

        "# Create the regression plot again with the subset\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))\n",
        "sns.regplot(data=subset_df, x='Height', y='Weight', scatter_kws={\"alpha\":0.5})\n",
        "plt.title(\"Regression Plot of Athlete Height vs. Weight (Sample of 500)\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Height (cm)\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Weight (kg)\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n"

        "# Counting the medals by country, differentiating between medal types\n",
        "medal_counts = df[df['Medal'].notna()].groupby(['Team', 'Medal']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)\n",
        "medal_counts['Total'] = medal_counts.sum(axis=1)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Sort by the total number of medals won\n",
        "top_countries = medal_counts.sort_values('Total', ascending=False).head(10)\n",
        "top_countries\n"
      ]
    },

      "source": [
        "# Filter dataset for awarded medals\n",
        "medal_data = df.dropna(subset=['Medal'])\n",
        "\n",
        "medals_by_team = medal_data['Team'].value_counts().head(10)  # Top 10 teams for better readability\n",
        "\n",
        "# Plot a pie chart for medals won by each team\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))\n",
        "plt.pie(medals_by_team, labels=medals_by_team.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=140, colors=sns.color_palette(\"Paired\", 10))\n",
        "plt.title(\"Distribution of Medals Won by Top 10 Teams\", fontsize=16, weight='bold')\n",
        "plt.show()\n"
      ]
    },

        "india_medals = df[(df['Team'] == 'India') & (df['Medal'].notna())]\n",

        "# Count the medals by type for India\n",
        "india_medal_counts = india_medals['Medal'].value_counts()\n",
        "total_india_medals = india_medals.shape[0]\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"India's Medal Counts by Type:\")\n",
        "print(india_medal_counts)\n",
        "print(\"\\nTotal Medals Won by India:\", total_india_medals)\n"
      ]

        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import seaborn as sns\n",
        "\n",
        "# Filter the dataset for Indian athletes\n",
        "india_data = df[df['Team'] == 'India']\n",
        "\n",
        "# 1. Histogram for India's participation over the years\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))\n",
        "sns.histplot(data=india_data, x='Year', bins=15, kde=True, color='skyblue')\n",
        "plt.title(\"Number of Indian Athletes in Each Olympic Year\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Year\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Number of Athletes\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "# 2. Histogram for medals won by India over the years\n",
        "# Filter only rows where a medal was won\n",
        "india_medals = india_data.dropna(subset=['Medal'])\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))\n",
        "sns.histplot(data=india_medals, x='Year', bins=15, kde=True, color='orange')\n",
        "plt.title(\"Number of Medals Won by India in Each Olympic Year\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Year\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Number of Medals\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n"
      ]
    },
